holidays.name: National Chocolate Covered Raisin Day
holidays.description: A day to celebrate the humble raisin by dunking it in chocolate and eating it by the handful, ideally at a movie theater or while pretending it's a healthy snack.
holidays.origin: Like many American food days, it appears to be a promotional observance that grew out of the snack industry and food-calendar enthusiasts, with no single documented founder.
holidays.funFact: Chocolate covered raisins have long been a classic movie theater candy, and they are often sold under brand names like Raisinets, which debuted in the 1920s.

holidays.name: National Cocktail Day
holidays.description: A day for raising a glass to the art of mixology, whether that means a fancy craft cocktail or a lovingly shaken classic made at home.
holidays.origin: The day is an unofficial observance popularized through bar and spirits marketing, and its date has varied, with March 24 being one commonly listed.
holidays.funFact: The word cocktail was defined in print in 1806 in an upstate New York newspaper as a mix of spirits, sugar, water, and bitters.

holidays.name: World Tuberculosis Day
holidays.description: A serious but important global awareness day dedicated to educating the public about tuberculosis and the push to end the epidemic.
holidays.origin: It marks the date in 1882 when Dr. Robert Koch announced he had discovered the bacterium that causes TB, and the World Health Organization recognizes it each year.
holidays.funFact: Koch's discovery was so significant that he later won the 1905 Nobel Prize in Physiology or Medicine.

holidays.name: Digital Learning Day Adjacent: Cheesesteak Day
holidays.description: A day to honor the Philadelphia cheesesteak, a sandwich of thinly sliced beef, melted cheese, and fried onions on a long roll, and to argue loudly about the right cheese.
holidays.origin: National Cheesesteak Day is a food observance tied to Philadelphia's famous sandwich, which is credited to Pat Olivieri, who reportedly created it in the 1930s.
holidays.funFact: The cheesesteak legend says Pat Olivieri, a hot dog vendor, first grilled beef for himself, and a cab driver asked for one of his own, leading to a sandwich empire.

holidays.name: Chocolate Covered Raisin Day's Rival: Cheerleading Hug Day Alternative: Barbie Day Alternative: Day of Remembrance for Archbishop Romero
holidays.description: The International Day for the Right to the Truth Concerning Gross Human Rights Violations honors victims of human rights abuses and the dignity of those who fight for justice.
holidays.origin: The United Nations established it in 2010, choosing March 24 to honor Archbishop Óscar Romero, who was assassinated in El Salvador in 1980.
holidays.funFact: Archbishop Romero was canonized as a saint by Pope Francis in 2018.
